annotations.title: Fill a public template and get a PDF

description: Fill a public template with the user's data and return a PDF link. Data must match the template's schema (see get_public_template); a missing field comes back as a list of what to ask for, and costs nothing. The designs of one document take the same data (the five resume designs, as do the packing slip and the delivery note), so switching design is the same call with a different slug, and `color` prints a design in another of its colours. Works without an API key within the daily free limit.

color.description: Optional: one of the template's colours (list_public_templates), e.g. navy. Left out, the default.
